newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sees Q1 inflation, trade gap falling.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sees Q1 inflation, trade gap falling.

text.p: Vietnam's General Statistics Office issued a raft of economic estimates for the first quarter of 1997 on Tuesday showing consumer prices for the period up 2.1 percent and a trade deficit expected at $935 million.
Separate figures for year-on-year industrial output growth showed an increase for March estimated at 12.7 percent.
The consumer price and trade data showed both inflation and the trade gap seen falling during the period compared to last year's levels.

In the first quarter of last year consumer prices reached 4.3 percent. The General Statistics Office said the 1997 first quarter inflation estimate of 2.1 percent represented the lowest increase for the period since 1991.
Imports were estimated at $2.723 billion against exports of $1.788 billion, giving a trade gap of $935 million for the period against a 1996 Q1 figure of $1 billion.
Tuesday's industrial output figures also showed first quarter growth for 1997 expected at 14 percent compared to last year's level for the period of 12.4 percent.
